company.name: Sword Health
company.shortDescription: Sword Health offers AI-powered physical therapy solutions for pain recovery at home.
company.description: Sword Health provides AI-driven physical therapy solutions designed to assist users in managing pain from home. The company focuses on musculoskeletal conditions and pelvic health, offering programs that promote recovery and injury prevention. Sword Health utilizes technology to deliver personalized care and support, ensuring users receive tailored treatment plans. By combining clinical expertise with innovative tools, the company aims to enhance patient outcomes and overall health management. Their approach integrates data-driven insights to facilitate continuous improvement in therapy effectiveness.
